INITIAL_EXPLORATION.name: INITIAL_EXPLORATION
INITIAL_EXPLORATION.objective: Place individual objects to observe baseline detector responses.
guidelines: Test each object (A, B, C) individually
Record which objects alone activate the detector
Clear the detector between tests for clean observations

COMBINATION_TESTING.name: COMBINATION_TESTING
COMBINATION_TESTING.objective: Test object combinations to identify interaction effects.
guidelines: Test pairs: AB, AC, BC
Test all three: ABC
Compare combined results to individual results
Note which combinations change the detector state

transitions.condition: If results are confusing, go back to singles

HYPOTHESIS_EVALUATION.name: HYPOTHESIS_EVALUATION
HYPOTHESIS_EVALUATION.objective: Evaluate evidence to determine rule type and blickets.
guidelines: Consider: does each blicket alone activate? (disjunctive)
Consider: are all blickets needed together? (conjunctive)
List evidence for and against each hypothesis
Identify any remaining ambiguities

transitions.condition: When you have a clear hypothesis
If hypothesis is unclear, test more combinations

VERIFICATION.name: VERIFICATION
VERIFICATION.objective: Run confirming tests and submit your answer.
guidelines: Design a test that would distinguish your hypothesis from alternatives
Run the confirming test
If confirmed, submit your answer
If disconfirmed, return to hypothesis evaluation

DIMENSION_DISCOVERY.name: DIMENSION_DISCOVERY
DIMENSION_DISCOVERY.objective: The standard conjunctive/disjunctive framework doesn't explain your observations. Consider alternative causal dimensions: order of placement, probabilistic activation, or changing rules.
guidelines: Review ALL observations for patterns beyond which objects are present
Consider: does the ORDER of placement matter?
Consider: is activation PROBABILISTIC (same setup, different results)?
Consider: has the RULE CHANGED over time?
Form a new hypothesis about the causal mechanism

transitions.condition: Test new hypothesis with targeted experiments
If new hypothesis is clear enough to verify

ORDER_TESTING.name: ORDER_TESTING
ORDER_TESTING.objective: Test whether the order of object placement affects activation. Systematically vary placement order while keeping the same objects.
guidelines: Clear detector completely before each test
Place the SAME objects in DIFFERENT orders
Record: which order activated, which didn't
Try at least 3 different orderings

MODERATOR_DETECTION.name: MODERATOR_DETECTION
MODERATOR_DETECTION.objective: The causal rule appears to have changed. Investigate what triggers rule changes and identify the new rule.
guidelines: Count how many successful activations occurred before the change
Re-test all objects individually under the new regime
Re-test combinations to identify the new rule
Consider: does the rule cycle or switch permanently?

transitions.condition: Start fresh exploration under new rule
If new rule pattern is clear
